summary: Configured node1 as a persistent passive FTP destination for the scanner account. The account is confined to the dedicated dropbox, supports uploads and retrievals, rejects anonymous access, and cannot retrieve host files outside the chroot. The supplied sample scan transferred successfully with matching SHA-256 hashes. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Installed signed vsftpd 3.0.2 compatible with RHEL 7.9 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured scanner-only authentication, non-login shell, writable chroot, passive ports 30000–30049, SELinux permissions, and persistent firewall rules.
Uploaded and retrieved the supplied sample scan from node2 using passive FTP.
Verified anonymous rejection and confinement from host files.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified service and data recovery.

evidence.requirement: Compatible FTP service and dedicated scanner dropbox
evidence.summary: Shows vsftpd 3.0.2, scanner-only configuration, active/enabled service, passive firewall range, SELinux settings, and dropbox ownership/modes.

evidence.requirement: Passive upload and retrieval, including the supplied sample scan
evidence.summary: Forced passive transfers succeeded and retrieved files matched their source SHA-256 hashes before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Anonymous access unavailable and host files outside the dropbox inaccessible
evidence.summary: Anonymous authentication returned FTP 530 and retrieval of /etc/passwd returned FTP 550 while scanner file retrieval remained successful.
Baseline boot ID and health were captured, reboot was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and vsftpd, firewall/SELinux state, stored data, and passive retrieval recovered.
Baseline data and boot ID were captured, reboot was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and node2 recovered with intact staged data and successful passive retrieval from node1.
